title: Workspace settings
personal: Workspace settings belong to an organization. Switch to one from the menu at the top of the sidebar.
readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.

general.name: Workspace name
general.nameHint: Shown in the workspace switcher and to people you invite.
general.languageHint: New cards start in this language. Each card can change it in the Studio.
general.planHint: What this workspace can do and how many cards, people and chips it includes.
general.idHint: Integrations and the API use this to reach this workspace.
general.privacyHint: Linked under the contact form on every card, so visitors can read how their details are handled. Leave empty to show none.

brand.logoHint: Shown in the workspace switcher. A square image works best.
brand.colourHint: New cards start with this colour. Each card can still choose its own.
brand.invalid: Use a six-digit colour code, like #2563eb.

files.intro: Images everyone in the workspace can reuse: logos, backgrounds, product shots. Copy a file's link to use it in a card.
files.onlyImages: Only images can be uploaded here for now.
files.emptyBody: Upload the logos and images your team uses on its cards.
files.deleteBody: Cards that already use its link will show a broken image.

security.requireHint: Everyone in this workspace signs in with a code from their phone as well as a password.
security.isOn: Required. Members without it are asked to set it up before they can use this workspace.
security.isOff: Optional. Each person decides for their own account.
security.yoursFirst: Turn it on for your own account first, so you can't lock yourself out.
security.withoutHintOn: They'll be asked to set it up the next time they open the workspace.
security.withoutHintOff: If you require it, these people will be asked to set it up.

export.title: Export workspace data
export.hint: Everything in this workspace as one JSON file: members, cards, leads with their history, pipeline, chips, occasions and ready messages. Only owners can do this.

convert.title: Working with a team?
convert.hint: Make this a company or team workspace to invite people. Your cards, leads and chips stay as they are.
convert.name: Company or team name
